title: HSBC UK cuts 15 mortgage rates and comments on Budget announcements - About HSBC | HSBC UK
description: HSBC UK cuts 15 mortgage rates and comments on Budget announcement.

headings.text: HSBC UK cuts 15 mortgage rates and comments on Budget announcements

body: Share link to this page on X
Share link to this page on Facebook

Following confirmation that HSBC UK will be taking part in the Government’s newly announced Help To Buy scheme, the bank has announced rate cuts of up to 0.1% across its range of LTVs.
The latest mortgage rate cuts include:
2 year fixed rate (£999 fee) at 60% LTV down 0.05% to 1.14%.
5 year fixed rate (fee saver) at 60% LTV down 0.05% to 1.64%.
2 year fixed rate (fee saver) at 75% LTV cut by 0.10% to 1.79%.
2 year fixed rate 90% LTV (£999 fee) reduced by 0.10% to 3.14%, with the fee-saver equivalent cut by 0.10% to 3.34%.

Michelle Andrews, HSBC UK’s Head of Buying a home, commented: “Supporting the UK housing market can take many forms. Last year we continued lending at 90% LTVs during very challenging times, worked hard to work within lockdown rules to continue to value properties in a timely way and continued to on-board broker partners to help give more people access to our products.

“Now we are cutting mortgage rates again on 15 products across our range of LTVs, and we are also happy to support the Government’s new Help To Buy scheme, which was announced in yesterday’s Budget. This will make a real difference to people moving on and up the housing ladder, and will undoubtedly help realise the home-buying dreams of many.”

On the extension of the Stamp Duty Land Tax, also announced in the Budget, Michelle Andrews added: “We know the temporary relief of Stamp Duty Land Tax has made a real difference and we welcome the extension. It will not only help those who are in the throes of buying a property and concerned about missing the deadline, it will also help keep momentum in the housing and mortgages markets.”
Steve Gracey, HSBC UK Media Relations – steve.gracey@hsbc.com / 020 7991 4118

HSBC UK serves around 14.5 million customers across the UK, supported by 32,000 colleagues. HSBC UK offers a complete range of retail banking and wealth management to personal and private banking customers, as well as commercial banking for small to medium businesses and large corporates.

HSBC Holdings plc, the parent company of HSBC, is headquartered in London. HSBC serves customers worldwide from offices in 64 countries and territories in its geographical regions: Europe, Asia, North America, Latin America, and Middle East and North Africa. With assets of US$2,984bn at 31 December 2020, HSBC is one of the world’s largest banking and financial services organisations.
